Introduction

Nexus is the missing brain in your AI workflow.

Every time you start a new AI session, you lose context. You re-explain your project structure, remind the AI about your conventions, and watch your token budget evaporate on information you've provided a dozen times before.

Nexus fixes this. It gives your AI assistant persistent memory, instant access to up-to-date documentation, and a curated registry of MCP servers—all through a single MCP connection.

Documentation Search

Semantic search across 50+ indexed libraries. Get accurate, up-to-date code examples without hallucinations.

Persistent Memory

Your AI remembers your projects across sessions. Store decisions, conventions, and learnings.

MCP Server Registry

Discover and configure MCP servers for databases, APIs, and cloud services with copy-paste configs.

Token Efficiency

Semantic search returns only relevant chunks. Save 90%+ on context tokens compared to full docs.

Quick Start​

Add Nexus to your AI client in 30 seconds:

Add to Claude Code
claude mcp add nexus -- npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcp-remote https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse

✓ Added MCP server nexus

Or add directly to your MCP config file:

Claude Desktop / Cursor / VS Code
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nexus": {
      "url": "https://mcp.nexus.yogan.dev/sse"
    }
  }
}

That's it. Your AI now has access to documentation search, persistent memory, and the MCP server registry.

Ready to dive in?

Head to the Installation Guide for detailed setup instructions, or jump straight to the CLI Quickstart to set up your editors automatically.

How It Works​

Example: Querying Documentation
# Your AI needs to know about React hooks

AI: Let me search the React documentation...

→ Calling query-docs
  libraryId: react
  query: "useEffect cleanup function best practices"

Nexus: Found 5 relevant results

1. Cleaning up Effects
   Return a cleanup function to avoid memory leaks...
   Source: react.dev/reference/react/useEffect

2. Synchronizing with Effects
   Some components need to synchronize with external systems...

┌─────────────────┐     MCP      ┌─────────────────┐
│   AI Client     │◄────────────►│     Nexus       │
│ (Claude, etc.)  │              │   MCP Server    │
└─────────────────┘              └────────┬────────┘
                                          │
                    ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐
                    │                     │                     │
               ┌────▼────┐          ┌─────▼─────┐        ┌──────▼──────┐
               │  Docs   │          │  Memory   │        │  Registry   │
               │ Search  │          │  Store    │        │  Database   │
               └─────────┘          └───────────┘        └─────────────┘

Features at a Glance​

Documentation Tools​

ToolDescription
resolve-libraryFind library IDs for documentation queries
query-docsSearch indexed documentation with semantic search
get-library-infoGet detailed library metadata and stats
list-librariesBrowse all indexed documentation

Memory Tools​

ToolDescription
save-memoryStore project context, decisions, and learnings
recall-memoriesRetrieve relevant memories using natural language
get-project-contextLoad all context for a specific project
list-memoriesBrowse and manage stored memories

Server Registry Tools​

ToolDescription
discover-serversFind MCP servers by capability or category
get-server-infoGet detailed server documentation
get-server-configGenerate ready-to-use MCP configurations
